test_title: PYST 18: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

We has travelled / to many states / of India to get / an essence of its diversity.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect usage of the verb "**has**" instead of "**have**" in "**We has travelled**."
 
• The subject "**We**" requires the verb "**have**" to be grammatically correct.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**We have travelled**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"**We have travelled** to many states of India to get an essence of its diversity."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "an essence of its diversity" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "to many states"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "of India to get"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
